items.title: Michael White interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 10, 2025
items.q: He’s the one that told me about them, and I bought them

ctx.x: He’s the one that told me about them, and I bought them because I don’t like to bring my good horns out in parades and funerals. But what I found is as good as it sounds out on the job, it just doesn’t quite have the same bite as my good wooden clarinets.
So if you were recording you’d take out your wooden clarinet?
